title: One turn of the ReAct loop: check the weather and decide on a picnic

events.label: State the task
events.detail: 「明天北京适合野餐吗？」The task is a single sentence; how to look things up, how many times, and when to stop — the agent decides all of it inside the loop. That is the essential difference from E01's single call.

events.label: Assemble the loop: system prompt + tool list
events.detail: The system prompt states the role and the stopping condition, plus the tool list (only get_weather in this example). At this point the context holds no observations yet — the loop has not started turning.

events.label: Thought #1: decide the next action
events.detail: An ordinary chat call, but the output is not an answer — it is a decision: 「check the weather first」 → a structured tool_call JSON. The model's output is constrained to the tool list.

events.label: Action: get_weather(北京, 明天)
events.detail: The client validates the arguments and actually executes the call. Execution always lives on the client — the model only 「requests a call」; it never touches the network itself.

events.label: Observation: sunny, 26℃, light breeze
events.detail: The tool result is fed back into the context verbatim as the observation. The loop completes one turn: Thought → Action → Observation, and the context grows.

events.label: Thought #2: enough information, switch to answering
events.detail: The model judges that the observation already covers the task (no further lookups needed) and decides to stop calling tools and produce the final answer. When to stop is also a decision the model makes inside the loop.

events.label: Final answer: good for a picnic
events.detail: 「明天北京晴，26℃，微风，适合野餐。」— a natural-language reply carrying a judgment, not another tool_call.

events.label: Loop exit: stopping condition met
events.detail: The task-completion check fires and the loop ends. Had the model judged the information insufficient, it would return to r3 and keep turning — guardrails such as a round cap decide the maximum number of turns (expanded in A07's runaway experiment).
